english.meaning: to put on a list; to include
english.note: 列入考慮 means to put under consideration.

exampleSentences.english: It’s just under consideration. So even ranking 20th counts.
exampleSentences.traditional: 列入考慮之中啫。噉你排二十噉樣都係考慮。
